description: Vercel AI SDK v7 streamText of one OpenAI chat answer with usage.
notes: ai 7.0.162 does not emit spans. Spans come from @ai-sdk/otel OpenTelemetry, passed on telemetry.integrations. The model is openai.chat. The mock waits 120 ms before the first chunk and splits the answer into 4 chunks. Three spans: invoke_agent, chat, and agent_step. The chat span measures gen_ai.client.operation.duration, time_to_first_chunk, and time_per_output_chunk, in seconds. ai.response.msToFirstChunk and ai.stream.msToFirstChunk are absent. Token counts are copied: input 20, output 8, cache_read 0.
